Test.description: A test of std/test: it fails where its body panics, an assert among them

Group.description: A group of tests; groups nest, and a test's full name is `group > test`

Import.description: Import a name from a package or a file

Function.description: A function; the last expression of its body is what it answers

Type.description: A type with fields; Equals, Hash, Show and copy come with it

Type with cases.description: A type whose values are one of its cases

Trait.description: A trait; a type says `with Area` to have it

Match.description: A match, which covers every case

Assert.description: Panics where the condition is false, and names the source and every value it read
